To drive a page you need to **find** elements and **act** on them. The Browser
library finds elements with selectors; the most reliable is a **test id** —
`data-testid=login-submit`. Test ids are added for automation and survive
restyles, where CSS classes and layout do not.

Acting is two keywords for now: **`Fill Text`** types into a field, and
**`Click`** presses a button or link.

`headless=True` on `New Browser` runs the engine without opening a visible
window — the norm for automation and CI. Drop it to watch the run in a real
browser while you debug.

## Task 1 — Sign in using data-testid locators

**Goal:** create `checks/login.robot` that signs `primary_user` into the shop
using test-id locators, and confirms the catalog appears.

Here is the same sign-in as a different user. Adapt it to `primary_user`.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Reviewer Signs In
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    reviewer_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    Get Text    data-testid=catalog-title    contains    Catalog
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** the suite uses `Fill Text` and `Click` on test-id locators.

<!-- hint -->
Fill both fields by their test ids: `Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    primary_user`
and `Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
`Click    data-testid=login-submit` to submit, then confirm you landed with
`Get Text    data-testid=catalog-title    contains    Catalog`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Primary User Signs In
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    primary_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    Get Text    data-testid=catalog-title    contains    Catalog
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run it green against the shop

With the shop running, run:

```bash
uv run robot checks
```

**Check:** the test `Primary User Signs In` passes.
